newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian parliament approves 1997 budget for EMU.
newsitem.headline: Belgian parliament approves 1997 budget for EMU.

text.p: Belgium's parliament approved on Thursday a tough government budget designed to prepare the country for European economic and monetary union (EMU).

The 1997 budget cuts government borrowing to below three percent of gross domestic product (GDP), as required by the Maastricht Treaty on EMU, using a combination of spending cuts and tax rises totalling 80 billion Belgian francs ($2.5 billion).
It was approved by 81 votes against 62, representing the combined vote of the governing coalition parties against the opposition, the Belga news agency reported.
